# Job Chapter 31 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 427v–428r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOB_031_page_001.jpg, JOB_031_page_002.jpg

---

**31:1** "A-covenant [berit] I-have-cut [karati] with-my-eyes [le-einai]; and-how [u-mah] shall-I-gaze [etbonen] upon a-virgin [al betulah]?

**31:2** And-what [is] the-portion [cheleq] of-God [Eloah] from-above [mi-ma'al], and-the-inheritance [nachalat] of-the-Almighty [Shaddai] from-on-high [mi-meromim]?

**31:3** Is-it-not calamity [eid] for-the-unrighteous [le-avval], and-disaster [nekher] for-the-workers of-iniquity [po'alei aven]?

**31:4** Does-he not see [yir'eh] my-ways [derakhai], and-all my-steps [tse'adai] does-he-count [yispor]?

**31:5** If I-have-walked [halakhti] with falsehood [im shav], and-my-foot [ragli] has-hastened [vattachas] to deceit [al mirmah] —

**31:6** let-him-weigh-me [yishqeleni] in-scales [be-moznei] of-justice [tsedeq], and-let-God [Eloah] know [veyeda] my-integrity [tummati].

**31:7** If my-step [ashuri] has-turned [nattah] from-the-way [min ha-derekh], and-after my-eyes [einai] my-heart [libbi] has-gone [halakh], and-to-my-hands [be-khappai] a-spot [mu'um] has-clung [davaq] —

**31:8** let-me-sow [ezra'ah] and-another [acher] eat [yokhel], and-let-my-offspring [tse'etsa'ai] be-uprooted [yeshoretshu].

**31:9** If my-heart [libbi] has-been-enticed [niftah] upon a-woman [al ishah], and-at-the-door of-my-neighbor [re'i] I-have-lurked [aravti] —

**31:10** let-my-wife [ishti] grind [titchan] for-another [le-acher], and-upon-her let-others [acherim] bow-down [yikhre'un].

**31:11** For that [is] a-shameful-thing [zimmah], and-that [is] an-iniquity [avon] for-the-judges [pelilim].

**31:12** For it [is] a-fire [esh] [that] consumes [tokhal] to Abaddon [ad avaddon], and-in-all my-increase [tevuati] it-would-uproot [tesharesh].

**31:13** If I-have-rejected [im ma'asti] the-case [mishpat] of-my-male-servant [avdi] or-my-female-servant [va'amati] in-their-contending [be-rivam] with-me —

**31:14** then-what shall-I-do [e'eseh] when-God [El] rises-up [yaqum]? And-when-he-visits [yifqod] — what shall-I-answer-him [ashivennu]?

**31:15** Did-not he-who-made-me [oseni] in-the-womb [ba-beten] make-him [asahu]? And-did-not-One [echad] fashion-us [yekhunennu] in-the-womb [ba-rechem]?

**31:16** If I-have-withheld [emna] the-poor [dallim] from-[their] desire [me-chefets], or-the-eyes of-the-widow [almanah] I-have-caused-to-fail [akalleh];

**31:17** or-I-have-eaten [va'okhel] my-morsel [pitti] alone [levaddi], and-the-fatherless [yatom] has-not eaten [lo akhal] from-it;

**31:18** — for from-my-youth [mi-ne'urai] he-grew-up [gedelani] with-me as-with-a-father [ke-av], and-from-the-womb of-my-mother [mi-beten immi] I-guided-her [anchenah] —

**31:19** if I-have-seen [er'eh] one-perishing [oved] for-lack of-clothing [mi-beli levush], or-a-needy-person [evyon] with-no covering [kesut];

**31:20** if his-loins [chalutsav] have-not blessed-me [berakuni], and-from-the-fleece of-my-sheep [gez kevasai] he-was-not warmed [yitchamam];

**31:21** if I-have-raised [hanifoti] my-hand [yadi] against the-fatherless [yatom], because I-saw [er'eh] in-the-gate [ba-sha'ar] my-help [ezrati] —

**31:22** let-my-shoulder [ketiffi] fall [tippol] from-its-shoulder-blade [mi-shikhmah], and-my-arm [ezro'i] from-its-socket [mi-qanah] be-broken [tishaver].

**31:23** For calamity [eid] from-God [El] [was] a-dread [pachad] to-me, and-before-his-majesty [mi-se'eto] I-was-not able [lo ukhal].

**31:24** If I-have-made [samti] gold [zahav] my-trust [kisli], and-to-fine-gold [la-ketem] I-have-said, 'My-confidence [mivtachi]';

**31:25** if I-have-rejoiced [esmach] because great [rav] [was] my-wealth [cheili], and-because much [kabbir] my-hand [yadi] had-found [mats'ah];

**31:26** if I-have-looked [er'eh] at-the-light [or] when-it-shone [ki yahel], or-the-moon [yareach] walking [holekh] in-splendor [yaqar];

**31:27** and-my-heart [libbi] was-secretly [baseter] enticed [vayift], and-my-hand [yadi] kissed [vattishaq] my-mouth [le-fi] —

**31:28** this also [gam hu] [is] an-iniquity [avon] for-the-judges [pelilim], for I-would-have-been-false [kichashti] to-God [la-El] above [mi-ma'al].

**31:29** If I-have-rejoiced [esmach] at-the-destruction [be-fid] of-my-hater [mesan'i], and-I-exulted [hitorerarti] when-evil [ra] found-him [metsa'o] —

**31:30** and-I-have-not given [lo natatti] my-palate [chikki] to-sin [la-chato] by-asking [lish'ol] with-a-curse [be-alah] his-life [nafsho] —

**31:31** if the-men of-my-tent [ohal] have-not said [amru], 'Who can-find [yitten] one-not-satisfied [lo nisba] from-his-meat [mi-besaro]?'

**31:32** In-the-street [ba-chuts] the-sojourner [ger] did-not lodge [lo yalin]; my-doors [daltai] I-opened to-the-road [la-orach].

**31:33** If I-have-covered [kissiti] like-Adam [ke-adam] my-transgressions [pesha'ai], to-hide [litmon] in-my-bosom [be-chub'i] my-iniquity [avoni] —

**31:34** because I-feared [e'erots] a-great multitude [hamon rabbah], and-the-contempt of-families [mishpachot] terrified-me [yechitteni], and-I-was-silent [va'eddom] — I-did-not go-out [lo etse] [of] the-door [petach] —

**31:35** Who would-give [mi yitten] to-me one-who-hears-me [shome'a li]! Behold, my-mark [tavi] — let-the-Almighty [Shaddai] answer-me [ya'aneni]! And-a-document [sefer] my-opponent [ish rivi] has-written [katav]!

**31:36** Surely upon my-shoulder [shikhmi] I-would-carry-it [essa'ennu]; I-would-bind-it [e'endennu] to-me as-a-crown [atarot].

**31:37** The-number of-my-steps [tse'adai] I-would-declare [aggiddennu] to-him; as-a-prince [ke-nagid] I-would-approach-him [aqrevennu].

**31:38** If my-land [admati] cries-out [tiz'aq] against-me, and-together [yachad] its-furrows [telameiha] weep [yivkayun];

**31:39** if its-produce [kochah] I-have-eaten [akhalti] without silver [beli kesef], and-the-soul [nefesh] of-its-owners [be'aleha] I-have-caused-to-breathe-out [hiffachti] —

**31:40** let-thorns [choach] grow instead-of wheat [tachat chittah], and-weeds [va-bosh'ah] instead-of barley [tachat se'orah]."

The-words of-Iyyov are-ended [tammu divrei Iyyov].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "a covenant with my eyes":** Job's oath begins with sexual ethics — he pledged not to lust. The covenant (*berit*) with his own eyes treats temptation as a solemn, binding agreement.

**v.15 — "Did not the one who made me in the womb make him?":** The most revolutionary verse in the chapter — Job grounds the rights of servants in shared creation. Master and slave are formed by the same God in the same womb. This is radical egalitarianism.

**v.33 — "like Adam":** Hebrew *ke-adam* — "like Adam" or "like mankind." If "like Adam," Job references the first human's attempt to hide transgression in Eden. This is one of the few possible allusions to the Genesis narrative in Job.

**v.35 — "my mark":** Hebrew *tavi* — often taken as "my signature" (the final letter of the Hebrew alphabet, *tav*, used as a mark or signature). Job signs his testimony and demands God's response.

**Colophon — "The words of Job are ended":** A scribal notation marking the end of Job's speeches. Everything that follows (Elihu, the theophany) comes from other voices.

*— EMET*
